name: ASMR Relaxation
description: Smooth, intimate tuning for whispers, soft speech, and salon personal attention videos. Smooths sibilance to prevent listening fatigue.

filters.comment: Subsonic high-pass to remove mic thumps & plosives
Anti-sibilance cut for harsh 's' and 'sh' sounds
Gentle top-end smoothing for zero-fatigue relaxation

notes: Experimental starting profile based on general audio heuristics (subsonic HP, vocal warmth, sibilance cut) and subjective listening. Not derived from physical acoustic measurements of the PRO X SE.
